dc_to_ac_efficiency.description: Typical battery-to-AC efficiency of a hybrid inverter over the load fraction, not the datasheet of a specific model.

ac_to_dc_efficiency.description: Typical AC-to-battery efficiency of a hybrid inverter over the load fraction, not the datasheet of a specific model.

power_derating.description: Typical derating: full power up to 45 degC ambient, then linearly down to 60 % at 60 degC and to 0 at 65 degC.
